jacob.name: Jacob
jacob.title: Jacob (Yaqub)
jacob.dict: Son of Isaac and father of Joseph and his brothers; twice called Israel (3:93, 19:58). In surah 12 he grieves for Joseph until his eyes turn white, and his sight returns when Joseph's shirt is laid on his face. On his deathbed he asks his sons what they will worship after him (2:133).

jesus.name: Jesus
jesus.title: Jesus (Isa)
jesus.dict: "The Messiah, Jesus, the son of Mary, the Messenger of God, and His Word that He conveyed to Mary, and a Spirit from Him" (4:171). Born of a virgin (3:45-47, 19:16-22), he speaks from the cradle, heals the blind and the leper and raises the dead by God's leave (3:49, 5:110), and is given the Gospel (5:46). The Quran denies that he is God or God's son (5:72-75, 19:35), and says of his enemies, "they did not kill him, nor did they crucify him, but it appeared to them as if they did"; God raised him to Himself (4:157-158).

jews.name: The Jews
jews.title: The Jews
jews.dict: The Jews of the Prophet's own time, as distinct from the Children of Israel of the stories. The Quran promises reward to those of them who believe in God and the Last Day and do right (2:62, 5:69), says the Torah holds guidance and light (5:44), and also charges some of them with altering words, breaking treaties and hostility to the believers (4:46, 5:82).

jinn.name: The jinn
jinn.title: The jinn
jinn.dict: Unseen beings made from fire before mankind (15:27), who, like humans, were created only to worship God (51:56) and will be judged. Some believe and some do not: a band of them hear the Quran and believe (46:29-32, 72:1-15). They worked for Solomon (34:12-14). Talal Itani's translation sometimes calls them sprites.

job.name: Job
job.title: Job (Ayyub)
job.dict: He cries to his Lord in his affliction and is healed; his family is given back to him, "and their like with them" (21:83-84, 38:41-44). "We found him patient. What an excellent servant!"

john.name: John
john.title: John (Yahya)
john.dict: Son of Zechariah, "confirming a Word from God", honorable, chaste, a prophet (3:39); given wisdom as a child, devout and kind to his parents (19:12-15). The Quran does not mention his baptizing or his death.

jonah.name: Jonah
jonah.title: Jonah (Yunus)
jonah.dict: He flees to a laden ship, is swallowed by the fish, and cries from the darkness, "There is no god but You! Glory to You! I was one of the wrongdoers!" (21:87). Cast up sick on the shore, he is sent to a hundred thousand or more, and they believe (37:139-148): the one town that believed in time (10:98). He is also called the man of the fish (68:48).

joseph.name: Joseph
joseph.title: Joseph (Yusuf)
joseph.dict: His whole story is told in surah 12, the only surah given to a single story: the dream, the well, the wife of the Egyptian who bought him, prison, the king's dream, the storehouses, and his reunion with his brothers and his father. He is named only twice outside it (6:84, 40:34).
